battle.name: 法瑞戰爭
battle.brief: 一八〇五年法國向瑞典宣戰，法瑞戰爭開啟；北德戰略主要圍繞瑞典波美拉尼亞與沿海航路，法軍尋求切斷英國航運並迫使瑞典屈服，進而牽動北歐戰略局勢。輪發槍（Wheellock pistol）至一八〇五年已非野戰主力，僅可能作為軍官、衛兵或地方民兵配備的舊式手槍。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 1805年的法瑞戰爭，是第三次反法同盟在歐洲大陸的總稱。法國與俄國直接交戰，但奧地利及其軍隊構成多瑙河戰線的主要支柱；英國以現金補助、海上封鎖和遠征計畫協同作戰，瑞典與那不勒斯亦站在同盟一方，陸戰規模則有限於北方與南部。法國陣線包括法軍、西班牙軍、拿破崙控制的義大利王國，以及巴伐利亞、符騰堡等德意志盟邦。戰爭由巴伐利亞的烏爾姆起，沿雷根斯堡、多瑙河谷、維也納一路轉向奧洛穆茨與奧斯特里茨；同一時期英國皇家海軍在加的斯外海與英吉利海峽牽制法國艦隊，因此這是一場海陸並行的同盟戰爭，而核心仍是奧地利的軍隊能否與俄軍會合。
countriesEn: The Franco-Russian War of 1805 was the European continental phase of the Third Coalition. France and Russia fought directly, but Austria and its armies formed the principal pillar of the Danube front. Britain coordinated through subsidies, naval blockade, and projected expeditions, while Sweden and Naples also belonged to the coalition, although their land operations remained limited in the north and south. The French side included the French army, Spanish forces, the Kingdom of Italy under Napoleon's control, and German allies such as Bavaria and Württemberg. The war began around Ulm in Bavaria and moved through Regensburg, the Danube valley, and Vienna toward Olomouc and Austerlitz. At the same time, the Royal Navy challenged the French fleet off Cádiz and in the English Channel. It was therefore a combined maritime and continental conflict, but the central strategic question remained whether the Austrian and Russian armies could unite.
people: 法軍方面的最高指揮是拿破崙，他直接掌握主力軍的部署，並把達武第三軍、貝納多特第六軍、拉納第五軍、蘇爾特第四軍、穆拉騎兵預備隊與莫爾捷預備隊分散使用。卡爾・馬克指揮奧軍主力，卻把大量兵力滯留在烏爾姆及多瑙河上游，未能及時迎接俄軍；最後不但失去會師機會，也只能在退路被封閉後交出剩餘軍力。俄軍最高指揮為庫圖佐夫，他沿加利西亞與摩拉維亞緩慢推進，兵力過度分散於前衛、後衛和行李縱隊；巴格拉強率前衛在西線周旋，多克圖羅夫與米拉多羅維奇在多瑙河谷掩護主力，布克斯赫維登則率領聯軍中部縱隊。亞歷山大一世與弗朗茨二世都到了奧斯特里茨，前者希望親自決定戰役，後者則要保存奧軍殘部；本尼格森實際調度聯軍中央各縱隊，卻未能在道路與天候限制下維持同步。馬塞納率法軍進入維也納，莫爾捷參與杜倫施泰因戰鬥，達武在霍爾布倫攔住聯軍前衛。萬達姆與聖伊萊爾指揮法軍中央突擊，拉納與穆拉承擔南翼壓制。威靈頓則以英方軍事觀察員身分在場，觀察聯軍縱隊如何因彼此失去聯絡而暴露普拉岑高地。
peopleEn: Napoleon commanded the main French force and dispersed his corps among Davout's III Corps, Bernadotte's VI Corps, Lannes's V Corps, Soult's IV Corps, Murat's cavalry reserve, and Mortier's reserve. Karl Mack led the main Austrian army but kept a large portion of it around Ulm and the upper Danube instead of moving east to meet the Russians; he consequently lost both the opportunity for a junction and the ability to withdraw. Kutuzov commanded the Russian army as it advanced slowly through Galicia and Moravia, with troops extended among the advance guard, rearguard, and baggage columns. Bagration led the western vanguard, Dokhturov and Miloradovich covered the main force along the Danube, and Buxhöwden commanded the central Allied columns. Alexander I and Francis II both came to Austerlitz. Alexander expected to influence events personally, while Francis wanted to preserve what remained of the Austrian army; Bennigsen handled the practical movement of the Allied center but could not keep the columns synchronized under the constraints of road and weather. Masséna entered Vienna with French troops, Mortier took part in the fighting at Dürenstein, and Davout checked the Allied advance guard at Hollabrunn. Vandamme and Saint-Hilaire commanded the French central attack, while Lannes and Murat provided pressure on the southern wing. Wellington attended as a British military observer and saw how the Allied columns lost contact with one another and exposed the Pratzen Heights.
kits: 交戰軍隊的武器系統均可追溯至1805年以前。法軍步兵主要使用一七七七年式夏萊維爾燧發滑膛槍及一七八六年改型，槍口約八毫米；俄軍使用一七九六年式燧發步槍，奧軍使用一七九八年式韋恩德爾燧發步槍，兩者口徑約十三點七毫米。這些步槍均為前膛單發滑膛設計，步兵以紙包定裝彈供應黑火藥與彈丸，沒有後膛瞄擊槍、針發槍或可供大軍使用的後膛炮。法軍野戰炮以格里博瓦爾系統的四磅、六磅與八磅炮為主，並配備可快速轉移的騎兵炮；俄軍使用十匹馬的獨角獸快速炮隊，奧軍則以六磅野戰炮和較重砲位支援。炮彈仍以實心圓彈和霰彈為主，藥量由炮隊火藥箱及藥包供應。骑兵方面，一八〇三年起列裝的法軍重騎兵鋼製胸甲、奧軍輕騎兵的彎刀與長矛、俄軍近衛騎兵裝備及哥薩克偵察用馬匹都已在役。通信依靠軍用信使、傳令兵與各級參謀遞送命令。渡河依靠專用浮橋舟車，後勤另有團級彈藥車、行李車、馬匹飼料車和野戰救護車；因此一場快速戰役能否維持，不只取決於射擊，也取決於浮橋、馬匹和補充彈藥能否跟上。
kitsEn: Every weapon system used by the opposing armies can be traced to 1805 or earlier. French infantry principally carried the Model 1777 Charleville flintlock musket and its Model 1786 modification, with an approximately 8 mm bore. Russian troops used the Model 1796 flintlock musket, while Austrian troops carried the Model 1798 Werndl flintlock musket, both with a bore of roughly 13.7 mm. All were single-shot muzzleloaders. Infantry ammunition was issued in paper cartridges containing black powder and projectiles; there were no breech-loading rifles, percussion weapons, or breech-loading artillery available to these armies. French field artillery was based on the Gribeauval system, especially 4-, 6-, and 8-pounder guns, supplemented by rapidly transferable horse batteries. The Russians employed ten-horse unicorn horse-artillery brigades, while the Austrians relied on 6-pounder field guns and heavier position batteries. Artillery ammunition remained round shot and canister, with powder carried in battery powder boxes and measured packets. Cavalry equipment included the steel cuirasses adopted by the French heavy cavalry from 1803, Austrian hussar sabres and lances, Russian Guard cavalry equipment, and horses used by Cossack reconnaissance parties. Orders traveled through military couriers, mounted messengers, and staff officers. River crossings depended on dedicated pontoon wagons, while ammunition wagons, baggage vehicles, forage wagons, and field ambulances formed the rear-area structure. The ability to sustain rapid combat therefore depended not only on firing but also on keeping bridges, horses, and reserve ammunition moving with the formations.
tactics: 法軍先把主力集中於巴伐利亞，從萊茵河多處渡河，切斷奧軍與尚在遠方集中的俄軍之間的聯繫。達武第三軍最早越過萊茵河並占領烏爾姆，拿破崙隨後抵達；奧軍退入城防後，既無法迅速東撤，也缺乏控制河面與外部道路的條件，於十月二十日投降。之後達武在雷根斯堡渡過多瑙河，使殘存奧軍各部彼此分離，維也納與南翼聯軍被孤立。俄軍退却時，馬里亞策爾的巴格拉強前衛以步兵和炮兵阻擋穆拉騎兵；杜倫施泰因的俄軍後衛在多瑙河狹窄河谷內逐次抵抗法軍，保存了庫圖佐夫的主力；霍爾布倫的達武前哨又攔住布克斯赫維登的縱隊。這些遲滯行動沒有改變兵力劣勢，卻讓俄軍得以避免被法軍各縱隊逐段吃掉。奧斯特里茨的中央會戰始於聯軍的縱隊運動。布克斯赫維登企圖以數個縱隊由申布倫方向越過金河，先占普拉岑高地，再向塔雅河與法軍右翼會合；巴格拉強與米拉多羅維奇在北面應付達武。可是聯軍前進道路狹窄，縱隊之間距離過大，前方並未持續偵察中央法軍。十二月一日夜間，拿破崙得到報告後判斷中央高地上敵軍薄弱，隨即把萬達姆師作突擊主力，令聖伊萊爾及友軍預備隊支援，命令拉納掩護左翼，貝納多特和蘇爾特壓住北面，達武守住塔雅河渡口。十二月二日清晨的濃霧遮蔽了法軍集結，萬達姆各旅攀上普拉岑北坡，奪回高地；拉納曾以反擊迫使部分法軍退讓，但聖伊萊爾與後續部隊趕到後重新穩住陣線。聯軍中央縱隊隨後反攻，試圖奪回高坡，卻因道路擁塞和指揮不連續而失敗。貝納多特在塔瓦羅日納方向的推進曾被米拉多羅維奇牽制。午後，穆拉以法軍騎兵和騎兵炮衝擊巴格拉強的翼側，奪取部分火炮與軍旗，但俄軍近衛步兵和炮兵仍守住陣地，使聯軍右翼沒有立即崩潰。達武其後由特爾尼茨方向渡過金河，打開北部平原；聯軍主力才向北退卻。夜間低溫、融雪、狹窄道路和縱隊堵塞使法軍追擊無法保持連續，聯軍雖遭重創，仍有相當兵力渡過金河脫離戰場。
tacticsEn: The French first concentrated their main force in Bavaria, crossed the Rhine at several points, and severed the link between the Austrian army and the Russians assembling farther east. Davout's III Corps crossed the Rhine early and occupied Ulm; Napoleon arrived later. Once the Austrians withdrew behind the city's defenses, they could neither withdraw rapidly eastward nor control the river and roads outside the walls, so they capitulated on 20 October. Davout then crossed the Danube at Regensburg, separating the surviving Austrian formations and isolating Vienna and the Allied southern flank. During the Russian withdrawal, Bagration's advance guard at Mariazell used infantry and artillery to check Murat's cavalry. At Dürenstein, the Russian rearguard fought successive actions in the narrow Danube gorge and preserved Kutuzov's main army. Davout's outposts at Hollabrunn then held Buxhöwden's columns. These delaying actions did not correct the Allied numerical disadvantage, but they prevented Murat and Mortier from destroying the Russian army in separated segments. The central engagement at Austerlitz began with the movement of the Allied columns. Buxhöwden intended to send several columns across the Goldbach from the Schönbrunn direction, seize the Pratzen Heights, and then unite with the French right toward the Thaya. Bagration and Miloradovich faced Davout in the north. Narrow roads stretched the Allied formations, the leading troops did not continuously reconnoiter the French center, and the gap between columns grew as they advanced. On the night of 1 December, Napoleon received reports indicating that the center of the heights was weak. He made Vandamme's division the assault force, with Saint-Hilaire and other reserve troops supporting it, ordered Lannes to cover the left flank, Bernadotte and Soult to contain the northern sector, and Davout to retain the Thaya crossings. On the morning of 2 December, fog concealed the French concentration. Vandamme's brigades climbed the northern slope of the Pratzen and recaptured the heights. A counterattack by Lannes briefly drove part of the French force back, but Saint-Hilaire and the arriving supporting divisions restored the line. The Allied center then counterattacked in an attempt to regain the ridge, yet road congestion and interrupted command prevented a coordinated effort. Bernadotte's advance toward Tvarožná was checked by Miloradovich. In the afternoon, Murat charged Bagration's flank with French cavalry and horse artillery, capturing some guns and standards, although Russian Guard infantry and batteries remained in place and prevented an immediate collapse of the Allied right. Davout subsequently crossed the Goldbach near Telnitz and opened the northern plain, after which the main Allied body began withdrawing north. Night cold, thawing snow, narrow roads, and column congestion prevented the French from maintaining an uninterrupted pursuit, and a substantial part of the Allied army escaped across the Goldbach despite heavy losses.
data: 軍事的日序相當清楚。1805年5月9日英國對法宣戰，8月9日奧地利宣戰，9月8日俄國公布開戰；九月下旬達武第三軍自曼海姆一帶渡過萊茵河，10月9日占領烏爾姆，10月17日拿破崙抵達該城，10月20日馬克投降。10月31日，達武在雷根斯堡架設浮橋渡過多瑙河；11月8日發生馬里亞策爾阻擊戰，11月11日法軍在杜倫施泰因與俄軍後衛交戰，11月13日法軍進入已撤空的維也納，11月16日達武在霍爾布倫擋住布克斯赫維登。十一月底至十二月一日，聯軍各縱隊由申布倫向北移動，中央與右翼之間的聯絡逐漸鬆脫，12月2日爆發奧斯特里茨會戰。從烏爾姆到維也納，路線約二百公里；雷根斯堡至維也納約一百七十公里；維也納至奧洛穆茨約一百九十公里，至普拉岑一帶約一百二十公里。法軍利用團級彈藥車和營連所攜紙包彈藥維持供應，快速推進時則必須縮短補給車隊，否則道路會被後勤車輛堵塞。普拉岑一役的常見兵力概估是法軍六萬至七萬、聯軍八萬至九萬，炮兵約為一百三十餘門對近兩百門；這些數字包含作戰中陸續投入的支隊，不能視為開戰時完全集中的名冊。烏爾姆以整軍投降告終，不是一場全殲戰；奧斯特里茨的傷亡、被俘與失散數字又因統計口徑及後續傷病而分歧，因此不宜列出單一精確總數。
dataEn: The military chronology is clear. Britain declared war on France on 9 May 1805, Austria on 9 August, and Russia published its declaration on 8 September. In late September Davout's III Corps crossed the Rhine around Mannheim, occupied Ulm on 9 October, was joined by Napoleon on 17 October, and received Mack's capitulation on 20 October. Davout bridged the Danube at Regensburg on 31 October. The action at Mariazell followed on 8 November, the fighting at Dürenstein on 11 November, French troops entered the evacuated Vienna on 13 November, and Davout held Buxhöwden at Hollabrunn on 16 November. From late November to 1 December, the Allied columns moved north from Schönbrunn, and contact between the center and right steadily weakened. The Battle of Austerlitz followed on 2 December. The route from Ulm to Vienna was approximately 200 kilometers, from Regensburg to Vienna roughly 170 kilometers, from Vienna to Olomouc about 190 kilometers, and from Vienna to the Pratzen area around 120 kilometers. The French sustained themselves with ammunition wagons at regimental level and paper cartridges carried in the infantry's ammunition boxes. During rapid advances they had to shorten their supply columns, or the roads would be blocked by rear-area traffic. Common estimates for Austerlitz place the French at approximately 60,000 to 70,000 men and the Allies at 80,000 to 90,000, with roughly 130 or more French guns against close to 200 Allied guns. Those totals include formations arriving during the battle and should not be treated as complete opening-day strength lists. Ulm ended in the surrender of an organized army rather than an annihilating defeat. Accounts of casualties, prisoners, and missing men at Austerlitz vary according to definition and later sickness, so no single exact total is used here.
cause: 戰爭源於1802年3月25日《亞眠和約》造成的暫時和平無法長期維持。英國與法國在荷蘭控制權、地中海基地、海外殖民地及貿易問題上始終無法達成協議，英國於1805年5月9日再度宣戰。拿破崙在萊茵河兩側的安全安排同樣惡化：法國控制漢諾威並吸收萊茵邦國的勢力，使俄國與奧地利相信法國早晚會進一步削弱歐洲均勢。英俄同盟以及俄奧軍事約定形成後，英國以補助維持遠征軍，亞歷山大一世則得到奧地利配合的承諾，第三次反法同盟因而逐漸形成。8月9日奧地利宣戰，9月8日俄國參戰，計畫由奧軍先在巴伐利亞攻擊法軍側翼，再與俄軍會合，英軍則以海上壓力及其他戰區的行動分散法國注意。拿破崙沒有等待各路聯軍完成集結，而是利用法軍在德國的內線位置，以多個軍從萊茵河向內集中，先切斷奧俄兩軍。聯軍計畫本身並非缺乏兵力，而是要求三支地理上分離的軍隊在相近時間進入同一戰區；奧軍遭各擊、俄軍行軍遲緩，加上各縱隊沒有共同指揮與可靠偵察，遂使法軍得以選擇烏爾姆和多瑙河中游的會戰條件。
causeEn: The war arose from the temporary peace created by the Treaty of Amiens on 25 March 1802, which could not be maintained. Britain and France could not settle their differences over Dutch control, Mediterranean bases, overseas colonies, and trade, and Britain declared war again on 9 May 1805. Napoleon's security arrangements along the Rhine were also deteriorating. French control of Hanover and the absorption of client states near the Rhine convinced Russia and Austria that France would eventually overturn the European balance. After the Anglo-Russian alliance and the Austro-Russian military convention took shape, Britain supported expeditions with subsidies, Alexander I obtained Austria's promise of cooperation, and the Third Coalition gradually formed. Austria declared war on 9 August and Russia announced its entry on 8 September. The intended plan was for the Austrian army to strike the French flank in Bavaria and then unite with the Russians, while British sea power and operations elsewhere diverted French attention. Napoleon did not wait for the separated Allied armies to assemble. Exploiting the French interior lines in Germany, he concentrated several corps inward across the Rhine and cut the Austrians from the Russians. The Coalition was not short of troops; its plan required three geographically separate armies to enter the same theater at nearly the same time. The Austrian defeat, the slow Russian march, and the absence of common command and dependable reconnaissance allowed France to choose the conditions at Ulm and in the middle Danube.
impact: 戰爭最直接的影響，是奧地利在短期內退出第三次反法同盟，多瑙河防線由法軍控制，法國得以把巴伐利亞、西南德意志、義大利北部與奧斯特里茨周邊連成一個受法軍巡邏或占領的戰略區域。普拉岑的勝利沒有消滅聯軍全部兵力，卻使俄國失去奧地利提供的陸軍配合，也使英國原先設想的遠征與補助難以在歐洲形成決定性會戰。海上的另一條戰線則朝相反方向發展：維爾納夫未按拿破崙的命令把法國主力艦隊集中於布洛涅，反而駛離加的斯，使尼爾森得以返回；10月21日特拉法爾加海戰使法國立即入侵英國的計畫失去海軍前提。此後法國在歐洲大陸的處境反而更有利，並在1806年推動萊茵邦聯、迫使奧地利接受更小勢力範圍；普魯士也在1805年底與巴黎簽約並交出部分領土。俄國雖在奧斯特里茨受挫，仍保留完整軍隊，後來與法國另行議和；它對法國的敵意延續到1806年，也影響其後俄普關係。作戰層面上，這次戰爭顯示法軍分散行軍、統一集中指揮與由中央突破縱線的實際效果，也暴露聯軍因道路、命令和戰場偵察失調而被各次分割的問題。
impactEn: The most immediate effect was Austria's rapid exit from the Third Coalition. The Danube front passed under French control, and France connected Bavaria, southwestern Germany, northern Italy, and the area around Austerlitz into a strategic zone patrolled or occupied by French forces. The victory at Pratzen did not annihilate the entire Allied army, but it deprived Russia of Austrian land support and made it difficult for British expeditions and subsidies to produce a decisive continental battle. The maritime struggle developed in the opposite direction. Villeneuve failed to concentrate the main French fleet at Boulogne as Napoleon intended and instead sailed away from Cádiz, allowing Nelson to return; the Battle of Trafalgar on 21 October removed the naval basis for an immediate invasion of Britain. France consequently enjoyed a stronger continental position and used it in 1806 to advance the Confederation of the Rhine and impose a narrower sphere on Austria. Prussia also reached an agreement with Paris in late 1805 and ceded territory. Russia retained an intact army despite Austerlitz and later concluded a separate peace with France; its hostility continued into 1806 and influenced later relations with Prussia. Operationally, the campaign demonstrated the practical value of dispersed marching, centralized concentration, and an attack through the center, while exposing how roads, command, and reconnaissance failures could divide the Allied army into separately vulnerable segments.
result: 12月4日拿破崙進入奧斯特里茨並提出停戰談判；12月6日雙方交換初步條件，12月8日簽訂軍事停戰，聯軍主力得以有序向北撤退。12月26日，奧地利在普雷斯堡與法國簽約，把威尼斯、依斯特拉和達爾馬提亞交給義大利王國，把蒂羅爾讓給巴伐利亞，把特倫蒂諾讓給符騰堡，並支付賠款、限制常備軍規模、放棄加入新的反法軍事安排。俄國沒有在普雷斯堡條約上接受與奧地利相同的政治處分，而是以停戰保存軍力，之後再與法國單獨議和，因此第三次反法同盟的瓦解首先表現為奧地利退出。英法戰爭也沒有隨普雷斯堡條約結束，海上衝突仍延續。就1805年大陸戰役而言，結果是法軍取得明確的戰術與戰略勝利，聯軍則失去作戰計畫、奧地利盟約和中央歐洲的協同位置；但這不是對聯軍的完全消滅，數萬聯軍仍保有再編與繼續作戰的能力。戰爭結束時，法國控制歐洲大陸中部與義大利的主要軍政樞紐，奧地利被迫退讓並分散其外交餘地，俄國則未受普雷斯堡條約直接約束，這些差異共同構成法國勝利與同盟失敗的最終形勢。
resultEn: Napoleon entered Austerlitz and proposed negotiations for an armistice on 4 December. The two sides exchanged preliminary terms on 6 December and signed a military armistice on 8 December, allowing the main Allied body to withdraw north. On 26 December Austria concluded the Treaty of Pressburg with France. It ceded Venetia, Istria, and Dalmatia to the Kingdom of Italy, transferred Tyrol to Bavaria and Trentino to Württemberg, paid an indemnity, accepted restrictions on its army, and gave up participation in a new anti-French military arrangement. Russia did not accept the same political treatment imposed on Austria in the Treaty of Pressburg. It used the armistice to preserve its army and later negotiated separately with France, so the disintegration of the Third Coalition first appeared in Austria's withdrawal. The Anglo-French war also continued beyond Pressburg, including at sea. For the continental campaign of 1805, the result was a clear French tactical and strategic victory. The Coalition lost its operational plan, Austria's alliance, and its coordinated position in central Europe. It was not the annihilation of the entire Allied force, since substantial numbers of Allied troops retained the ability to regroup and continue fighting. At the end of the campaign, France controlled the principal military and political centers of continental Europe and Italy, Austria had to concede and saw its diplomatic room restricted, and Russia remained outside the settlement of Pressburg. These differences together constituted the final shape of the French victory and the Coalition's failure.
